decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family that is very close to the firm's core hardware range, supported by its own R&D and broad system know-how, it fits existing capabilities and is therefore likely to be retained unless the portfolio is streamlined.

This door handle design is near the firm's established competence base in design-led architectural fittings, so the firm can learn from market feedback and improve it, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.

The electronic access system builds on the firm's existing access-control offer and matches its strategic move toward digital building organization, so with strong internal knowledge and innovation resources it is the product most likely to be kept.
